parsed.public_message: White holds the Central Heights and reaffirms the four-way pact: neutral to all, no first strike through t=450, then one full public turn of notice. No movement this turn. We will not enter the south lowland. Green's scout to our east is noted; we hold fire.

private_messages.Claude: Holding the crest, no step this turn. We will not enter the south lowland. If anyone climbs toward the Heights from the south, please tell me.
private_messages.GPT: Your camel archer at (730,830) is about 70 m from our eastern riders. We stay neutral, hold fire, and are not moving this turn. Please keep that scout east of x=760 and off the crest so the gap stays clear.
private_messages.Gemini: Heights are quiet and we are not moving. Pact stands: neutral through t=450, then one full public turn of notice before any stance change.

parsed.notes_to_self: T9 t=200. Pact LOCKED: neutral to all until t=450, then 1 full public turn of notice. If attacked: set that commander enemy the same turn, fight in place, no chase. HOLD all on crest. Ring 740 now, 660 at t=225. Burn if unmoved: crete 235m ~t439, thessaly 233m ~t440, volley 206m ~t461, hero 198m ~t475, sarissa 187m ~t488, odrysia 186m ~t489. T17 t=400: move ONLY crete+thessaly ~30m toward centre, stay on high ground N of cliff z~780. Main descent ~t470 via S corridor x=520-660; do not enter Claude's south lowland. GPT camel (730,830) ~72m E of odrysia: watch, do not chase; asked them east of x=760. GPT main claimed ~(680,630). Gemini holds West Plateau. End focus: heroes, elephants, champions, ranged. Losses 0.
parsed.explanation: The four-way ceasefire still holds, so White stands on the Central Heights and does not approach Green's camel scout just east of the crest.
